rng: numpy PCG64 (reference uses mulberry32; statistically equivalent)
sigma_method: symmetric floor assumption: sigma = (ceiling - proj)/1.645 [reference: (ceiling-floor)/3.29; floor not in lineup data]
ownership: salary-percentile proxy (no pre-lock DK ownership XHR). CAVEAT: proxy owns run 0.11-0.25, inflating absolute dup_risk into [0.5,0.9] for all lineups; dup_risk values are formula-faithful but only meaningful RELATIVELY within this set.
verdict_method: relative heuristic: dup_risk quartile within this 20-lineup set (top quartile=TRAP_OR_PASS, 3rd=CAUTION, bottom half=CERTIFIED; CV-based ABSTAIN_HIGH_VARIANCE override). NOT the live JEV decisions API.
gse_score_method: within-position percentile of DK FPPG across 587-player pool, 0-100, source=sample-vor (NOT nflverse processGrade)
